receipt.public_excerpt: Tao conjectured that the scalable nature of AI systems makes them “better suited for being systematically applied to the ‘long tail’ of obscure Erdős problems, many of which actually have straightforward solutions.”

evidence_items.explanation: Tao described the AI successes as falling on obscure problems that often have straightforward solutions. This matches the post's point that these results do not show deep, general problem-solving.

receipt.public_excerpt: counting eight different problems where AI models made meaningful autonomous progress on an Erdős problem, with six other cases where progress was made by locating and building on previous research. It’s a long way from AI systems being able to do math without human intervention

evidence_items.explanation: Only a handful of autonomous successes were recorded at the time, some built on existing literature, and humans were still needed. This supports 'isolated'.

evidence_items.publisher: Terence Tao (tao-web, AI-compiled summary reviewed by Tao)

receipt.public_excerpt: on the Erdős problems, as he measured it in January 2026, the true success rate was only a point or two — non-trivial in absolute count across a thousand-plus problems, but concentrated at the easy end, with no evidence at that point that the median problem was in reach.

evidence_items.explanation: Tao's January 2026 estimate was a 1-2% success rate, concentrated on easy problems. This backs the claim that the successes were isolated and not evidence of general competence.

receipt.public_excerpt: as of early 2026, yet to make real progress. That last qualification eroded quickly: by September 2026 he was reporting AI systems improving flagship bounds (bounded gaps between primes)

evidence_items.explanation: Confirms there was no progress on marquee problems in early 2026. It also notes stronger AI results by September 2026, which fall outside the claim's period.

unresolved_gaps: Whether solving math problems bears on 'AGI' at all is a judgment that evidence cannot fully settle.
